76% Moderate Risk (Volume Asymmetry & Lower Body Deficits)

Athlete demonstrates strong upper-body pushing and pulling hypertrophy volume, but total lower body stimulus (quads and posterior chain) is operating below Minimum Effective Volume (MEV). With 31 weeks until the ATHX Games 2027, the primary qualification risk lies in barbell squat and deadlift capacity alongside the 5km running pace gap. Rebalancing weekly volume toward lower-body compounds while protecting current systemic ACWR (0.84) is the mandatory training priority.
